revised_teaching_units.scope: Compare continuous six-step TinyDecoder training to resume after step three on a real Apple M4 Pro GPU.
revised_teaching_units.observation: Using full state reproduces the objective groups, weights and momentum exactly. Dropping only momentum preserves groups but changes weights, and dropping only MPS RNG changes the group selection and weights. Both negative controls start from identical weights. Single-device FP32 scope.
